notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP only - requests with a browser UA. robots.txt (checked first) has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web disallow and does not block /collections/*, so tier (a) was sufficient throughout; no Playwright/CDN or Chrome tab was needed. TREE: Shopify site. Built from union of homepage mega-menu (desktop submenu HTML) + sitemap_collections_1.xml + each parent collection page's own 'Shop By ...' subcategory swiper strip (class colour-circles-wrapper), which revealed real children not present in the top nav (e.g. Curtains & Sheers -> Sheer/Cotton/Window Curtains; Cushion Covers -> Fillers/Floor/Solid/Printed/Accent; Rugs -> Small/Medium/Large/Oversize/Printed/Woven; Bed Linen -> Bed Covers/Pillow Covers/Dohars/Quilts; Table Linen -> Table Mat/Cover/Runner/Napkins; Upholstery Fabrics -> Abstract/Geometric/Stripes&Checks/Floral&Botanical/Narrative). Recursed one more level into each newly found child page for its own subcategory strip; none had further real children (only self-referential or Sale links). Per parent-URL rule, no qty/link was recorded on any parent that has valid subcategories. QTY: exact exhaustive count via Shopify's public /collections/<handle>/products.json paginated at limit=250 (summed unique products across pages) - deterministic, not the inflated collection.products_count field. Cross-checked once (curtains vs its rendered HTML page-1 unique data-product-id count) and it matched. medium-rugs qty=0 confirmed genuine (page loads with h1 'Medium Size Rugs' and an explicit no-results state, not a fetch failure). EXCLUDED: 'Textile Collections' (/pages/designer-textile-collections) and 'Order Swatches' (/collections/fabric-swatches) - not product listing categories (editorial landing page / sample-ordering utility). All *-sale collections (curtains-sale, cushion-sale, bedlinen-sale, upholstery-sale, kitchen-table-linen-sale) - promotional, excluded per View-All/Sale rule. Orphaned sitemap-only collections not reachable from any live nav or subcategory strip (cotton-curtains, kitchen-linen, napkins/table-cover/table-mat/table-runner as standalone top-level sitemap entries duplicating the table-linens children already captured, tweed-upholstery, raffia-upholstery, velvet-upholstery-fabric, solid-textured-upholstery, woven-upholstery, home-fabrics, furnishing[=View All Textiles], dining-entertaining[=View All Dining], home-decor[=View All Decor]) - not part of the reachable category tree, skipped. STORAGE: no genuine Storage category exists on this site. The only nav node literally labelled STORAGE sits inside the FURNITURE mega-menu (Sideboards/sideboard, Cabinets & Cupboards/cabinet, Shelves & Bookcases/bookshelf, Chest Of Drawers/chest-of-drawers, View All Storage/storage-shelves) - per storage.md Storage Furniture Boundary these are classic furniture pieces explicitly filed under the site's Furniture top-level nav, so they belong to Furniture, not this task; skipped entirely (neither array). 'Organisers' (footer/mobile Decor menu, /collections/home-organization) was checked and found to contain only 3 products, all product_type PHOTOFRAMES tagged L1_HOME DECOR>L2_TABLE ACCENTS>L3_PHOTOFRAMES - a mislabeled/stale collection with zero actual storage products, excluded (primary product type is decorative photo frames, not storage). '/collections/basket-organisers' (sitemap only, 0 products, not linked from any live nav) excluded as orphaned+empty. No pet/bathroom/kitchen/office/laundry/outdoor storage categories exist anywhere in nav or sitemap. storage_rows is therefore correctly empty.
